decisions.choice: each person answers for their own sin: the theme of the chapter
decisions.reason: The exiles believed they were being punished for their ancestors' sins and that nothing they did could change it (verse 2). The LORD answers that each person is judged by their own conduct, and that anyone who turns from sin will live (verses 21-23, 30-32). The chapter is built like a case in law: a righteous man, his wicked son, and that son's righteous son (verses 5-18).

decisions.choice: The word of the LORD came to me, saying (L); came to me (B); The LORD gave me this message (R)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording set in the Jeremiah table.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic

records.literal_gloss: What [is it] to you, you who speak this proverb about [the] land of Israel, saying: Fathers eat sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are blunted?

en.L: What do you mean, you who use this proverb about the land of Israel, saying, "Fathers eat sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are blunted"?
en.B: What do you mean by repeating this proverb about the land of Israel: "The {{gender:parents|fathers}} eat sour grapes, but it is the children whose teeth are set on edge"?
en.R: Why do you keep quoting this saying about the land of Israel: "The {{gender:parents|fathers}} eat the sour grapes, but the children get the sour taste"?

pt.L: Que [querem dizer] vocês, que usam este provérbio a respeito da terra de Israel, dizendo: "Pais comem uvas verdes, e os dentes dos filhos ficam embotados"?

pt.R: Por que vocês vivem repetindo este ditado sobre a terra de Israel: "Os pais comem as uvas verdes, mas são os filhos que ficam com o gosto azedo na boca"?

fr.L: Qu’avez-vous, vous qui répétez ce proverbe au sujet du pays d’Israël, en disant : « Les pères mangent des raisins verts, et les dents des enfants sont agacées » ?

decisions.choice: the fathers eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are blunted: the children suffer for their parents' sins
decisions.reason: Unripe grapes leave the teeth feeling rough and dull. The proverb says that one generation does wrong and the next pays for it. The exiles used it to say that their punishment was unfair and that they could do nothing about it.

decisions.choice: the same proverb in Jeremiah 31:29
decisions.reason: Jeremiah quotes the same proverb and says that in days to come people will no longer use it, because each will die for their own sin (Jeremiah 31:29-30). Ezekiel says that it must stop now. In Jeremiah the first verb is "ate"; here it is "eat", a saying about what always happens.

decisions.choice: blunted: made dull, set on edge
decisions.reason: As in Jeremiah 31:29.

decisions.choice: the wording of Jeremiah 31:29 at each level
decisions.reason: The proverb keeps the published wording of Jeremiah 31:29 at each level, with "eat" for "ate" (m2), and the same gender setting for "parents".

decisions.choice: the wording of Jeremiah 31:29 at each level, with the present tense (’mangent’) where Ezekiel’s proverb has it
decisions.reason: The same proverb as Jeremiah 31:29 (m2); French keeps Jeremiah’s words and its gender span at B and R, and follows the Hebrew’s present tense here.

decisions.choice: The proverb worded as the published Jeremiah 31:29 at each level, with its {{gender:부모가|아버지들이}} span at B and R
decisions.reason: Ezekiel quotes the same saying; Korean keeps Jeremiah's wording so that the two passages read alike, as the English does. Here the gender span is used because Korean has two real wordings, 부모 and 아버지.

decisions.choice: the proverb in the words of Spanish Jeremiah 31:29 at each level, in the present tense
decisions.reason: The same proverb is quoted in Jeremiah 31:29; the Spanish keeps its wording so the two passages can be seen together.

decisions.choice: "los padres", "los hijos", with no gender span here or in 18:4 and 18:20
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" and "hijos" already include mothers and daughters, so the English parents/fathers spans have no Spanish counterpart (Deuteronomy 24:16 as published).

decisions.choice: the proverb as the Swahili Jeremiah 31:29 words it; "baba" (L), "wazazi" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same proverb is worded as in Jeremiah 31:29. Literal keeps "baba" (fathers); Balanced and Readable say "wazazi" (parents), as the English default does. Swahili has no gender span, because "wazazi" is simply the word for parents (as Jeremiah 31:29 and Deuteronomy 24:16); the same holds in verses 4 and 20.

decisions.choice: the proverb worded as Jeremiah 31:29 at each level
decisions.reason: Ezekiel quotes the same proverb as Jeremiah, so each level repeats the published Vietnamese of Jeremiah 31:29; Balanced and Readable put "cha mẹ" in a gender span where the English has one, as Deuteronomy 24:16 does.

decisions.choice: the wording of Jeremiah 31:29 in Portuguese at each level, in the present ("comem", "ficam")
decisions.reason: The same proverb (m2) keeps the words Jeremiah 31:29 has in Portuguese at each level ("embotados" L, "os dentes ásperos" B, "o gosto azedo na boca" R), with the present tense, as the English says "eat" here. "Os pais" already means fathers and mothers, so Balanced and Readable need no gender setting, as in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: The proverb in the Amharic of Jeremiah 31:29 ("ጎምዛዛ ወይን", "ጥርስ ጠረሰ", {{gender:ወላጆች|አባቶች}} at B and R), in the present tense
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 31:29 has the same proverb; its Amharic is kept word for word except the first verb, which Ezekiel's Hebrew has in the imperfect ("eat", as the English), so "ይበላሉ … ይጠርሳል" here against Jeremiah's "በሉ … ጠረሰ". "ምሳሌ መመሰል" (L) keeps the Hebrew's "use a proverb".

decisions.choice: खट्टे अंगूर; दाँत खट्टे होना (L, B); खट्टा स्वाद बच्चों को मिलता है (R)
decisions.reason: The proverb's "blunted" teeth (m3) are teeth set on edge by sour fruit; Hindi says this with its own idiom, दाँत खट्टे होना, which keeps the picture of sourness. Readable says the children get the sour taste, as the English does. Jeremiah 31:29 quotes the same proverb (m2): Literal and Readable take its Hindi words (पुरखा; खट्टा स्वाद बच्चों को मिला), in the present tense, as the Hebrew of Ezekiel has it.

decisions.choice: Отцы едят кислый виноград, а у детей зубы притупляются (L); оскомина на зубах у детей (B); кисло во рту у детей (R)
alternatives: ели кислый виноград, а у детей на зубах оскомина
decisions.reason: The proverb Jeremiah 31:29 also quotes (m2). Its wording follows the Russian Jeremiah 31:29 at each level, with the present tense of the Hebrew here. Literal says "кислый виноград", as Jeremiah, and keeps the "blunted" teeth (m3); Balanced says "оскомина", the Russian word for the sour sensation; Readable says it plainly. The present "едят" follows the Hebrew and the English.

decisions.choice: поговорка
decisions.reason: "Поговорка" for a saying people repeat, as at 12:22; "притча" is kept for a parable.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Родители|Отцы}}
decisions.reason: The same gender setting as the English Balanced and Readable: the fathers stand for every parent.

decisions.choice: mashal here "ことわざ" (every level; a saying, not the story of 17:2); the proverb in the words of JER 31:29 at each level: boser "酸いぶどう" (L), "酸っぱいぶどう" (B, R); qahah "歯が浮く" (every level).
alternatives: "歯が鈍くなる" (too literal for Japanese)
R "子どもの口が酸っぱくなる" (the first draft, for the English R "get the sour taste")
decisions.reason: m1, m3: the teeth set on edge by sour fruit; 歯が浮く is the Japanese idiom for that feeling, plain enough for Readable too. m2: Jeremiah quotes the same proverb (English the same at B and R), so the two books read alike word for word.

decisions.choice: 'avot "{{gender:親|父}}" (B, R) as the English gender span and as JER 31:29; banim "子ども" with no span (already inclusive); L "父たち…子ら" as the English L.
decisions.reason: Style §7: the inclusive form is the default, the traditional one the alternative, as DEU 24:16 and EZK 5:10.

en.L: [As] I live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, you will no longer have [occasion] to use this proverb in Israel.
en.B: As surely as I live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, this proverb will no longer be quoted in Israel.
en.R: As surely as I live, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}, you will not use this saying in Israel anymore.

pt.L: [Tão certo como] eu vivo, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, vocês não terão mais [ocasião] de usar este provérbio em Israel.
pt.B: Tão certo como eu vivo, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, este provérbio não será mais citado em Israel.
pt.R: Tão certo como eu vivo, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}, vocês não vão mais usar esse ditado em Israel.

fr.L: [Aussi vrai que] je suis vivant, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, vous n’aurez plus [l’occasion] de répéter ce proverbe en Israël.
fr.B: Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, on ne répétera plus ce proverbe en Israël.
fr.R: Aussi vrai que je suis vivant, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, vous ne répéterez plus ce dicton en Israël.

ko.L: 내가 살아 있음을 [두고 맹세한다]. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다. 너희가 이스라엘에서 다시는 이 속담을 쓸 [일이] 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 이스라엘에서 다시는 이 속담을 입에 올리지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 살아 있음을 두고 맹세한다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다. 너희는 이스라엘에서 다시는 이 말을 하지 않을 것이다.

es.L: Vivo yo, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, que no {{plural_you:tendrán|tendréis}} más [ocasión] de usar este proverbio en Israel.
es.B: Tan cierto como que yo vivo, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, que este proverbio ya no se repetirá en Israel.
es.R: Tan cierto como que yo vivo, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, ya no {{plural_you:usarán|usaréis}} este dicho en Israel.

sw.L: Kama niishivyo, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, hamtakuwa tena na [nafasi] ya kutumia methali hii katika Israeli.
sw.B: Kama niishivyo, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, methali hii haitanukuliwa tena katika Israeli.
sw.R: Kama niishivyo hakika, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}, hamtatumia tena msemo huu katika Israeli.

vi.L: [Thật như] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, các ngươi sẽ không còn [dịp] dùng câu tục ngữ này trong Y-sơ-ra-ên nữa.
vi.B: Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, câu tục ngữ này sẽ không còn được nhắc lại trong Y-sơ-ra-ên nữa.
vi.R: Thật như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} hằng sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, các ngươi sẽ không còn dùng câu nói này trong Y-sơ-ra-ên nữa.

am.L: ሕያው ነኝና፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ ይህን ምሳሌ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ዳግመኛ የምትመስሉበት [ምክንያት] አይኖራችሁም።
am.B: በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ ይህ ምሳሌ ከእንግዲህ በእስራኤል አይጠቀስም።
am.R: በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፤ ከእንግዲህ ይህን አባባል በእስራኤል አትጠቅሱም።

hi.L: मेरे जीवन की शपथ, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, इस्राएल में यह कहावत कहने का [अवसर] तुम्हें फिर न मिलेगा।
hi.B: मेरे जीवन की शपथ, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, इस्राएल में यह कहावत फिर कभी नहीं कही जाएगी।
hi.R: मैं अपने जीवन की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं, इस्राएल में तुम यह कहावत फिर कभी नहीं कहोगे।

ru.L: Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — не будет у вас больше [повода] употреблять эту поговорку в Израиле.
ru.B: Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — эту поговорку больше не будут повторять в Израиле.
ru.R: Клянусь своей жизнью, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — вы больше не будете повторять эту поговорку в Израиле.

ja.L: わたしは生きている――{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。あなたがたがイスラエルでこのことわざを用いることは、もう決してない。
ja.B: わたしは生きている、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は告げる。このことわざが、イスラエルで再び口にされることはない。
ja.R: わたしは生きている。そのわたしが誓って言う、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は言う。あなたたちは、もう二度とイスラエルでこのことわざを口にすることはない。

uk.L: [Як] {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} живу, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, у вас більше не буде [приводу] вживати цю приказку в Ізраїлі.
uk.B: Як {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} живу, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, цю приказку більше не повторюватимуть в Ізраїлі.
uk.R: Як {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} живу, каже Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, ви більше не казатимете цієї приказки в Ізраїлі.

decisions.choice: As I live, declares the Lord GOD (L); As surely as I live (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath follows the wording set at 16:48.

decisions.choice: The oath "As I live" "ሕያው ነኝና" (L, B), "በሕያውነቴ እምላለሁ" (R); "declares the Lord GOD" "ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" after the words at every level
decisions.reason: The oath keeps the Amharic of Numbers 14:28 (L, B) and Isaiah 49:18 (R, which says plainly that God swears). Adonai YHWH is "ጌታ" with the name span, the Ezekiel terms list's formula, used through chapters 18-23.

decisions.choice: मेरे जीवन की शपथ (L, B), मैं अपने जीवन की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ (R); प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है (L, B); प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's oath "As I live" is मेरे जीवन की शपथ at Literal and Balanced, as Numbers 14:28 and Jeremiah 22:24, and मैं अपने जीवन की शपथ खाकर कहता हूँ at Readable, as Ezekiel 5:11; "declares the Lord GOD" takes the prophets note's formula.

decisions.choice: Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} (L, B); Клянусь своей жизнью (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's oath in the wording the Russian Ezekiel uses at 14:16-20 (and Isaiah 49:18): "Жив {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}" at Literal and Balanced, Readable "Клянусь своей жизнью". The sentence-initial "Жив" leaves "{{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}" mid-sentence, so it takes the span.

decisions.choice: — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} (L); — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The prophets note's wording for "declares the Lord GOD", with "Владыка" for Adonai, as the Russian Ezekiel 11-14.

decisions.choice: 'im in a negative oath "決して…ない" (L), where the positive oath has "必ず".
decisions.reason: Japanese 必ず does not combine with a negative.

source.text: הֵ֤ן כָּל־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לִ֣י הֵ֔נָּה כְּנֶ֧פֶשׁ הָאָ֛ב וּכְנֶ֥פֶשׁ הַבֵּ֖ן לִי־הֵ֑נָּה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Look, all the souls [are] mine; as the soul of the father, so the soul of the son, [they are] mine. The soul who sins, it will die.

en.L: Look, all the souls [are] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}; as the soul of the father, so the soul of the son [is] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. The soul who sins, it will die.
en.B: Every life belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the life of the {{gender:parent|father}} as well as the life of the {{gender:child|son}}; both belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. The person who sins is the one who will die.
en.R: Every person belongs to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{gender:parents|fathers}} and {{gender:children|sons}} alike. The person who sins is the one who will die.

pt.L: Eis que todas as almas [são] {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}}; a alma do pai, tal como a alma do filho, [é] {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}}. A alma que peca, ela é que morrerá.
pt.B: Toda vida pertence a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, tanto a vida dos pais como a dos filhos; as duas pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Quem morrerá é a pessoa que pecar.
pt.R: Todas as pessoas pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, tanto os pais como os filhos. Quem vai morrer é a pessoa que pecar.

fr.L: Voici, toutes les âmes [sont] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; l’âme du père comme l’âme du fils [est] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. L’âme qui pèche, c’est elle qui mourra.
fr.B: Toute vie {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient, la vie {{gender:du parent|du père}} comme la vie {{gender:de l’enfant|du fils}} ; l’une et l’autre {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent. La personne qui pèche, c’est elle qui mourra.
fr.R: Chaque personne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient, les {{gender:parents|pères}} comme les {{gender:enfants|fils}}. La personne qui pèche, c’est elle qui mourra.

ko.L: 보아라, 모든 영혼이 내 것이다. 아버지의 영혼이나 아들의 영혼이나 모두 내 것이다. 죄를 짓는 그 영혼이 죽을 것이다.
ko.B: 모든 사람의 목숨이 내 것이다. {{gender:부모|아버지}}의 목숨도 {{gender:자식|아들}}의 목숨도 다 내 것이다. 죄를 짓는 그 사람이 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 모든 사람이 내 것이다. {{gender:부모|아버지}}도 {{gender:자식|아들}}도 다 내 것이다. 죄를 짓는 바로 그 사람이 죽을 것이다.

es.L: He aquí, todas las almas son {{deity_pronoun:mías|Mías}}; como el alma del padre, así el alma del hijo, {{deity_pronoun:mías|Mías}} son. El alma que peque, esa morirá.
es.B: Toda vida {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenece, tanto la vida del padre como la del hijo; ambas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen. La persona que peca es la que morirá.
es.R: Todas las personas {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen, tanto los padres como los hijos. La persona que peca es la que morirá.

sw.L: Tazama, nafsi zote [ni] {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}; kama nafsi ya baba, ndivyo nafsi ya mwana [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Nafsi itendayo dhambi, hiyo itakufa.
sw.B: Kila mtu ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, maisha ya mzazi pamoja na maisha ya mtoto; wote ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Mtu atendaye dhambi ndiye atakayekufa.
sw.R: Kila mtu ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, wazazi na watoto vilevile. Mtu atendaye dhambi ndiye atakayekufa.

vi.L: Kìa, mọi linh hồn đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; linh hồn của cha thế nào, thì linh hồn của con cũng thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thế ấy. Linh hồn nào phạm tội, linh hồn ấy sẽ chết.
vi.B: Mọi sự sống đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, sự sống của {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}} cũng như sự sống của {{gender:con cái|con trai}}; cả hai đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người nào phạm tội, chính người ấy sẽ chết.
vi.R: Mọi người đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, {{gender:cha mẹ|cha}} cũng như {{gender:con cái|con trai}}. Người nào phạm tội, chính người ấy sẽ chết.

am.L: እነሆ፣ ነፍሳት ሁሉ የእኔ [ናቸው]፤ የአባት ነፍስ እንደ ሆነች፣ እንዲሁ የልጅ ነፍስ የእኔ [ናት]። ኃጢአት የምትሠራ ነፍስ እርሷ ትሞታለች።
am.B: የሰው ሁሉ ሕይወት የእኔ ነው፤ {{gender:የወላጅ|የአባት}} ሕይወትም ሆነ የልጅ ሕይወት ሁለቱም የእኔ ናቸው። የሚሞተው ኃጢአት የሚሠራው ሰው ነው።
am.R: ሰው ሁሉ የእኔ ነው፤ {{gender:ወላጆችም|አባቶችም}} ልጆችም እኩል የእኔ ናቸው። የሚሞተው ኃጢአት የሚሠራው ሰው ነው።

hi.L: देखो, सब प्राण मेरे [हैं]; जैसे पिता का प्राण, वैसे ही पुत्र का प्राण, [वे] मेरे [हैं]। जो प्राण पाप करे, वही मरेगा।
hi.B: हर एक जीवन मेरा है; {{gender:माता-पिता|पिता}} का जीवन भी और {{gender:सन्तान|पुत्र}} का जीवन भी, दोनों मेरे हैं। जो व्यक्ति पाप करता है, वही मरेगा।
hi.R: हर व्यक्ति मेरा है, {{gender:माता-पिता|पिता}} भी और {{gender:बच्चे|पुत्र}} भी। जो व्यक्ति पाप करता है, वही मरेगा।

ru.L: Вот, все души — {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}}; как душа отца, так и душа сына — {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}}. Душа, которая грешит, — она умрёт.
ru.B: Каждая жизнь принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}: и жизнь {{gender:родителя|отца}}, и жизнь {{gender:ребёнка|сына}} — обе принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}. Умрёт тот человек, который грешит.
ru.R: Каждый человек принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, и {{gender:родители|отцы}}, и {{gender:дети|сыновья}}. Умрёт тот, кто грешит.

ja.L: 見なさい、すべての魂はわたしのものである。父の魂も子の魂も、同じようにわたしのものである。罪を犯す魂、それが死ぬ。
ja.B: すべての命はわたしのものである。{{gender:親|父親}}の命も{{gender:子|息子}}の命も、どちらもわたしのものである。罪を犯す者、その者が死ぬ。
ja.R: すべての人はわたしのものである。{{gender:親|父親}}も{{gender:子ども|息子}}も同じである。罪を犯す人、その人が死ぬのだ。

uk.L: Ось усі душі — {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}}; як душа батька, так і душа сина — {{deity_pronoun:мої|Мої}}. Душа, що грішить, — вона помре.
uk.B: Кожне життя належить {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, і життя {{gender:батьків|батька}}, і життя {{gender:дитини|сина}}; обоє належать {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}. Помре саме та людина, що грішить.
uk.R: Кожна людина належить {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, і батьки, і {{gender:діти|сини}}. Помре саме та людина, що грішить.

decisions.choice: the soul: the living person, a whole human life
alternatives: the soul as the part of a person that lives on after death
decisions.reason: The word *nefesh* means a living being, a person, or a life. Here it does not mean a soul as distinct from the body, but the person as a whole: every human life belongs to God. "The soul who sins" means the person who sins.

decisions.choice: the person who sins will die: each is judged for their own sin
decisions.reason: This is the answer to the proverb of verse 2. The Law already said that parents are not put to death for their children's sins nor children for their parents' (Deuteronomy 24:16). "Die" and "live" here are about the LORD's judgment: whether a person is condemned or spared and keeps their place among his people (verses 9, 13, 21). The chapter does not deny that sin harms the next generation (compare Exodus 20:5); it denies that anyone is condemned for sins they did not commit.

decisions.choice: the soul (L); the person (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *nefesh* in this verse and verse 20. Literal keeps the traditional "soul"; Balanced and Readable say "person", which is what the word means here (m1).

decisions.choice: parent, child (with father, son as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: Here the father and son stand for every parent and child, so Balanced and Readable use the gender setting, as Jeremiah 31:29 does. In the case of verses 5-18 the Hebrew describes a man, his son and his grandson, and there the words stay as they are.

decisions.choice: ’l’âme’ (L); ’la personne’ (B, R) for nefesh in 18:4 and 18:20
decisions.reason: The book’s term list: the word means the living person (m1), which Balanced and Readable say as the English does; Literal keeps ’l’âme’, feminine, so ’c’est elle qui mourra’.

decisions.choice: ’du parent’ / ’du père’ and ’de l’enfant’ / ’du fils’ (B) under the gender setting, with the article inside the span
decisions.reason: French ’de l’enfant’ and ’du fils’ differ in their article, so the span holds the whole phrase, as the English holds ’parent’ and ’child’.

decisions.choice: "영혼" (L), "사람" (B, R) for nefesh; "목숨" (B) where it is each one's life
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for 18:4 and 18:20; the shared footnote says nefesh is the living person, not a soul apart from the body.

decisions.choice: {{gender:부모|아버지}} and {{gender:자식|아들}} where the English has parent/father and child/son spans
decisions.reason: Korean has both wordings, so it keeps the English setting; Literal keeps 아버지 and 아들 as the Hebrew has them.

decisions.choice: "el alma que peque, esa morirá" (L); "la persona que peca es la que morirá" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Nefesh in 18:4 and 18:20 as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "nafsi" (L); "mtu" (B, R) for nefesh
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for Ezekiel 18:4 and 20: Literal keeps "nafsi", and Balanced and Readable say "mtu" (person), because the word means the whole living person, not a soul apart from the body.

decisions.choice: nefesh: "linh hồn" (L); "người" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms: Literal keeps the English Literal's "soul"; Balanced and Readable say "người", the living person the meaning decision describes, so the verse is not read as the afterlife of the soul. As 18:20.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:cha mẹ|cha}}", "{{gender:con cái|con trai}}"
decisions.reason: Here Vietnamese has two real wordings, so the gender spans follow the English and Deuteronomy 24:16; in the case law of 18:5-18 "người", "người ấy" and "mình" need no span.

decisions.choice: A alma que peca, ela é que morrerá (L); Quem morrerá é a pessoa que pecar (B); Quem vai morrer é a pessoa que pecar (R)
alternatives: A alma que pecar, essa morrerá
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "alma", Balanced and Readable say "pessoa", as the English (r-en-1). The sentence is worded afresh, putting the weight where the Hebrew puts it, on the one who sins, rather than following the familiar older wording. Verse 20 repeats it in the same words.

decisions.choice: os pais ... os filhos, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting for "parent/father" and "child/son". Portuguese says it in the plural, "os pais", "os filhos", which already take in mothers and daughters, as Jeremiah 31:29 does, so no setting is needed; Literal keeps the singular "pai", "filho" of the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "The soul who sins, it will die": L "ኃጢአት የምትሠራ ነፍስ እርሷ ትሞታለች"; B, R "የሚሞተው ኃጢአት የሚሠራው ሰው ነው"; the same wording in verse 20
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "ነፍስ" with its feminine agreement and the Hebrew's resumptive "it" ("እርሷ"); Balanced and Readable say "the person", as the English, with the cleft sentence that puts the weight on who dies.

decisions.choice: A gender span on parent/father only ("{{gender:የወላጅ|የአባት}}", "{{gender:ወላጆችም|አባቶችም}}"); "ልጅ", "ልጆች" with no span
decisions.reason: "ወላጅ" and "አባት" are two real Amharic wordings, as in Jeremiah 31:29; "ልጅ" already means a son or a child, so the English child/son setting has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God is carried by the honorific third person (वे, उन्होंने).

decisions.choice: प्राण (L); जीवन, व्यक्ति (B, R)
decisions.reason: Nephesh here is the living person, the whole human life (m1), not a soul apart from the body, so Literal says प्राण and Balanced and Readable say जीवन or व्यक्ति. आत्मा is kept for spirit (ruach). The chapter's key line, "the soul who sins shall die", is जो प्राण पाप करे, वही मरेगा (L), जो व्यक्ति पाप करता है, वही मरेगा (B, R), the same in verse 20.

decisions.choice: душа (L); жизнь, человек (B, R)
decisions.reason: Nefesh is the living person (m1): Literal keeps "душа", Balanced and Readable say "жизнь" and "человек", as the English says "life" and "person". The sentence on the sinner (m2) is worded so as not to copy the Synodal "душа согрешающая, она умрёт"; the same wording returns in verse 20.

decisions.choice: {{gender:родителя|отца}}, {{gender:ребёнка|сына}} (B); {{gender:родители|отцы}}, {{gender:дети|сыновья}} (R)
decisions.reason: The English gender setting at the same places: here the father and the son stand for every parent and child.

decisions.choice: nefesh "魂" (L), "命" / "者" (B), "人" (R), as the English soul / life, person; "罪を犯す魂、それが死ぬ" (L), "罪を犯す者、その者が死ぬ" (B), "罪を犯す人、その人が死ぬのだ" (R), word for word again in 18:20.
decisions.reason: m1: the living person, the whole life (footnoted); L keeps the one Hebrew word, B and R say the person, as PRO and PSA handle nefesh.

decisions.choice: "親" / "子" (B), "親" / "子ども" (R) as the English gender spans.
decisions.reason: Style §7.

source.text: וְאִ֖ישׁ כִּי־יִהְיֶ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And a man, if he is righteous and does justice and righteousness,

en.L: And if a man is righteous and does justice and righteousness,
en.B: Suppose there is a man who is righteous and does what is just and right,
en.R: Suppose there is a man who is righteous. He does what is fair and right.

pt.L: E, se um homem for justo e praticar o direito e a justiça,
pt.B: Imaginem um homem que é justo e faz o que é justo e certo,
pt.R: Imaginem um homem que é justo. Ele faz o que é correto e certo.

fr.L: Et si un homme est juste et pratique le droit et la justice,
fr.B: Supposons un homme qui soit juste et qui pratique le droit et la justice,
fr.R: Supposons qu’un homme soit juste. Il fait ce qui est équitable et juste.

ko.L: 어떤 사람이 의로워서 정의와 의를 행한다고 하자.
ko.B: 어떤 사람이 의로워서 정의와 의를 행한다고 하자.
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 의롭다고 하자. 그는 공정하고 옳은 일을 한다.

es.L: Y si un hombre es justo y practica el derecho y la justicia,
es.B: Supongamos que hay un hombre justo, que hace lo que es justo y recto,
es.R: Supongamos que hay un hombre justo. Hace lo que es justo y correcto.

sw.L: Na mtu, akiwa mwenye haki na kutenda hukumu na haki,
sw.B: Tuseme kuna mtu aliye mwenye haki, anayetenda haki na uadilifu,
sw.R: Tuseme kuna mtu aliye mwenye haki. Anatenda haki na uadilifu.

vi.L: Nếu một người là công chính và làm theo công lý và sự công chính,
vi.B: Giả sử có một người công chính, làm điều công bằng và chính trực,
vi.R: Giả sử có một người công chính. Người ấy làm điều công bằng và ngay thẳng.

am.L: ሰው ጻድቅ ቢሆን፣ ፍርድንና ጽድቅንም ቢያደርግ፣
am.B: እስቲ ጻድቅ የሆነ፣ ትክክልና ቅን የሆነውንም የሚያደርግ ሰው አለ እንበል።
am.R: እስቲ ጻድቅ የሆነ አንድ ሰው አለ እንበል። እርሱ ፍትሐዊና ትክክል የሆነውን ያደርጋል።

hi.L: और यदि कोई मनुष्य धर्मी हो, और न्याय और धार्मिकता के काम करे,
hi.B: मान लो कोई मनुष्य धर्मी है और वही करता है जो न्यायपूर्ण और उचित है,
hi.R: मान लो कोई आदमी धर्मी है। वह वही करता है जो न्याय का और सही है।

ru.L: И человек, если он праведен и творит правосудие и праведность,
ru.B: Допустим, есть человек праведный, который поступает справедливо и правильно,
ru.R: Допустим, есть праведный человек. Он поступает честно и правильно.

ja.L: また、もし人が正しい者であって、公正と正義を行うなら、
ja.B: ある人が正しい人で、公正で正しいことを行うとする。
ja.R: ある人が正しい人だとしよう。その人は、公平で正しいことをする。

uk.L: А якщо чоловік праведний і чинить правосуддя і праведність,
uk.B: Припустімо, що є чоловік праведний, який чинить те, що справедливе й правильне,
uk.R: Припустімо, що є чоловік праведний. Він чинить те, що чесне й правильне.

decisions.choice: if a man is righteous: the first of three cases, set out like the cases in the Law
decisions.reason: The chapter tells of three generations: a righteous man (verses 5-9), his violent son (verses 10-13), and that son's son, who does not follow his father's ways (verses 14-18). The form is that of the Law's case laws ("if a man ...", Exodus 21; Leviticus 20). The cases are about men because some of the laws named (verses 6, 11, 15) concern a man and his neighbor's wife; the principle applies to every person (verses 4, 20).

decisions.choice: justice and righteousness: what is fair and right
decisions.reason: The pair describes a life lived by God's standards toward God and toward others (Genesis 18:19; Amos 5:24). Verses 6-9 list what it means.

decisions.choice: justice and righteousness (L); what is just and right (B); what is fair and right (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two nouns. Balanced and Readable use the adjectives, which read more naturally after "does".

decisions.choice: ’le droit et la justice’ (L, B); ’ce qui est équitable et juste’ (R) for mishpat and tsedaqah
decisions.reason: As the prophets’ term list for the pair, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: "정의와 의" (L, B), "공정하고 옳은 일" (R) for mishpat and tsedaqah
decisions.reason: The Isaiah-Jeremiah note's pair, as Isaiah 9:6; R gives the plain sense, as the English R "fair and right".

decisions.choice: "el derecho y la justicia" (L); "lo que es justo y recto" (B); "lo que es justo y correcto" (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat and tsedaqah as the terms note sets them, kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "hukumu na haki" (L); "haki na uadilifu" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Justice and righteousness (mishpat and tsedaqah) as the Swahili Isaiah 28:17 words the pair; used the same way through this chapter.

decisions.choice: mishpat utsedaqah: "công lý và sự công chính" (L); "điều công bằng và chính trực" (B); "điều công bằng và ngay thẳng" (R)
decisions.reason: Used unchanged for this pair through the chapter. The man of the case law is "người ấy" at every level, which already covers anyone.

decisions.choice: o direito e a justiça (L); o que é justo e certo (B); o que é correto e certo (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two nouns of the pair (m2), "direito" for mishpat, what is fair, and "justiça"; Balanced and Readable use adjectives, as the English does (r-en-1). God speaks to the exiles with "vocês" ("Imaginem").

decisions.choice: "Justice and righteousness": L "ፍርድና ጽድቅ"; B "ትክክልና ቅን የሆነው"; R "ፍትሐዊና ትክክል የሆነው", the same through the chapter (verses 19, 21, 27)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the two nouns as the terms list gives mishpat and tsedaqah; Balanced and Readable say what is done, as the English levels. Balanced keeps the Hebrew conditional chain of verses 5-9 as a list of sentences after "አለ እንበል" (suppose), since one Amharic sentence would have to hold the verdict of verse 9 back for five verses.

decisions.choice: न्याय और धार्मिकता (L); न्यायपूर्ण और उचित (B); न्याय का और सही (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat and tsedaqah together mean what is fair and right (m2). Literal keeps the two nouns; Balanced and Readable say what such a person does. The same forms run through the chapter.

decisions.choice: правосудие и праведность (L); справедливо и правильно (B); честно и правильно (R)
decisions.reason: Mishpat and tsedaqah (m2): Literal keeps the two nouns, Balanced and Readable turn them into adverbs after the verb, as the English uses adjectives.

decisions.choice: tsaddiq "正しい者" (L), "正しい人" (B, R); mishpat utsdaqah "公正と正義" (L), "公正で正しいこと" (B), "公平で正しいこと" (R), the same at each level through 18:5-27.
decisions.reason: Watchman and prophetic conventions (EZK 3:20; ISA 1:17, 1:21); one form per level so the cases read as one law.

decisions.choice: L keeps the case as one conditional sentence over 18:5-9, each verse a run of "〜ず、" clauses; B and R set the case ("…とする" / "…としよう") and list the deeds in sentences.
decisions.reason: m1: set out like the cases in the Law; Japanese keeps each verse's deeds after its own marker.

source.text: אֶל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְעֵינָיו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל־גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֶת־אֵ֤שֶׁת רֵעֵ֨הוּ֙ לֹ֣א טִמֵּ֔א וְאֶל־אִשָּׁ֥ה נִדָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יִקְרָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: on the mountains he has not eaten, and his eyes he has not lifted to the idols of the house of Israel, and his neighbor's wife he has not defiled, and to a woman in impurity he has not come near,

en.L: [if] he has not eaten on the mountains, and has not lifted up his eyes to the filthy idols of the house of Israel, and has not defiled his neighbor's wife, and has not come near a woman in [her] impurity,
en.B: who does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the house of Israel, who does not defile his neighbor's wife or have relations with a woman during her period,
en.R: He does not eat at the mountain shrines. He does not look to the idols of the people of Israel for help. He does not commit adultery with his neighbor's wife. He does not have sex with a woman during her monthly period.

pt.L: [se] não comer sobre os montes, nem levantar os seus olhos para os ídolos imundos da casa de Israel, nem contaminar a mulher do seu próximo, nem se aproximar de uma mulher na [sua] impureza,
pt.B: que não come nos santuários dos montes nem olha para os ídolos da casa de Israel, que não contamina a mulher do seu próximo nem tem relações com uma mulher durante a menstruação,
pt.R: Ele não come nos santuários dos montes. Não olha para os ídolos do povo de Israel pedindo ajuda. Não comete adultério com a mulher do seu vizinho. Não tem relações sexuais com uma mulher durante a menstruação.

fr.L: [s’]il n’a pas mangé sur les montagnes, et n’a pas levé les yeux vers les idoles immondes de la maison d’Israël, et n’a pas souillé la femme de son prochain, et ne s’est pas approché d’une femme pendant [son] impureté,
fr.B: qui ne mange pas dans les sanctuaires des montagnes et ne se tourne pas vers les idoles de la maison d’Israël, qui ne souille pas la femme de son prochain et n’a pas de relations avec une femme pendant ses règles,
fr.R: Il ne mange pas dans les sanctuaires des montagnes. Il ne compte pas sur les idoles du peuple d’Israël pour l’aider. Il ne commet pas d’adultère avec la femme de son voisin. Il n’a pas de relations sexuelles avec une femme pendant ses règles.

ko.L: 그가 산 위에서 [제물을] 먹지 않고, 이스라엘 집의 더러운 우상들에게 눈을 들지 않으며, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히지 않고, 월경 중인 여자를 가까이하지 않으며,
ko.B: 그는 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹지 않고, 이스라엘 집의 우상들을 바라보지 않으며, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히지 않고, 월경 중인 여자와 잠자리를 같이하지 않는다.
ko.R: 그는 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹지 않는다. 그는 이스라엘 백성의 우상들에게 도움을 구하지 않는다. 그는 이웃의 아내와 간음하지 않는다. 그는 월경 중인 여자와 잠자리를 같이하지 않는다.

es.L: [si] no ha comido sobre los montes, ni ha alzado sus ojos a los ídolos inmundos de la casa de Israel, ni ha deshonrado a la mujer de su prójimo, ni se ha acercado a una mujer en [su] impureza,
es.B: que no come en los santuarios de los montes ni pone los ojos en los ídolos de la casa de Israel, que no deshonra a la mujer de su prójimo ni tiene relaciones con una mujer durante su menstruación,
es.R: No come en los santuarios de los montes. No busca la ayuda de los ídolos del pueblo de Israel. No comete adulterio con la mujer de su prójimo. No tiene relaciones sexuales con una mujer durante su período mensual.

sw.L: [ikiwa] hajala juu ya milima, wala hajainua macho yake kwa sanamu chafu za nyumba ya Israeli, wala hajamtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake, wala hajamkaribia mwanamke katika unajisi [wake],
sw.B: ambaye hali katika madhabahu za milimani wala hazitazamii sanamu za nyumba ya Israeli, ambaye hamtii unajisi mke wa jirani yake wala halali na mwanamke wakati wa hedhi yake,
sw.R: Hali katika madhabahu za milimani. Hazitazamii sanamu za watu wa Israeli ili zimsaidie. Hazini na mke wa jirani yake. Halali na mwanamke wakati wa hedhi yake ya kila mwezi.

vi.L: [nếu] người ấy đã không ăn trên các núi, không ngước mắt lên các thần tượng nhơ bẩn của nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, không làm ô uế vợ người lân cận, và không đến gần người đàn bà trong thời kỳ ô uế [của nàng],
vi.B: không ăn của cúng tại các miếu trên núi, không ngửa trông các thần tượng của nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, không làm ô uế vợ người lân cận, cũng không ăn nằm với người đàn bà đang có kinh nguyệt,
vi.R: Người ấy không ăn của cúng tại các miếu thờ trên núi. Người ấy không trông cậy vào các thần tượng của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Người ấy không ngoại tình với vợ người lân cận. Người ấy không ăn nằm với người đàn bà đang có kinh nguyệt.

am.L: በተራሮች ላይ ባይበላ፣ ዓይኖቹንም ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ጣዖታት ባያነሣ፣ የባልንጀራውንም ሚስት ባያረክስ፣ በርኩሰቷም ወዳለች ሴት ባይቀርብ፣
am.B: ይህ ሰው በተራሮች ላይ ባሉ መስገጃዎች አይበላም፤ ወደ እስራኤል ቤት ጣዖታትም አይመለከትም፤ የባልንጀራውን ሚስት አያረክስም፤ በወር አበባዋም ጊዜ ወደ ሴት አይደርስም።
am.R: በተራሮች ላይ ባሉ መስገጃዎች አይበላም። ለእርዳታ ወደ እስራኤል ሕዝብ ጣዖታትም አይመለከትም። ከባልንጀራው ሚስት ጋር አያመነዝርም። በወር አበባዋ ጊዜ ከሴት ጋር ግንኙነት አያደርግም።

hi.L: [यदि] उसने पहाड़ों पर नहीं खाया, और इस्राएल के घराने की घिनौनी मूरतों की ओर अपनी आँखें नहीं उठाईं, और अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी को अशुद्ध नहीं किया, और [उसकी] अशुद्धता में किसी स्त्री के पास नहीं गया,
hi.B: जो पहाड़ी पूजा-स्थलों पर भोजन नहीं करता और न इस्राएल के घराने की मूरतों की ओर ताकता है, जो न अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी को भ्रष्ट करता है और न मासिक धर्म के समय किसी स्त्री के पास जाता है,
hi.R: वह पहाड़ी पूजा-स्थलों पर भोजन नहीं करता। वह मदद के लिए इस्राएलियों की मूरतों की ओर नहीं देखता। वह अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी के साथ व्यभिचार नहीं करता। वह किसी स्त्री के साथ उसकी माहवारी के दिनों में यौन संबंध नहीं बनाता।

ru.L: на горах не ел, и глаз своих не поднимал к грязным идолам дома Израиля, и жены своего ближнего не осквернял, и к женщине во [время её] нечистоты не приближался,
ru.B: который не ест жертвенной пищи в святилищах на горах и не обращает взгляда к идолам дома Израиля, который не оскверняет жену своего ближнего и не сближается с женщиной во время её месячных,
ru.R: Он не ест жертвенной пищи в святилищах на горах. Он не ищет помощи у идолов народа Израиля. Он не вступает в связь с чужой женой. Он не ложится с женщиной во время её месячных.

ja.L: 山々の上で食べず、イスラエルの家の汚らわしい偶像に目を上げず、隣人の妻を汚さず、月経の汚れの中にある女に近づかず、
ja.B: その人は、山の上の礼拝所で食事をせず、イスラエルの家の偶像を仰ぎ見ず、隣人の妻を汚さず、月経中の女に近づかない。
ja.R: その人は、山の上の礼拝所で食事をしない。イスラエルの人々の偶像に助けを求めない。隣人の妻と姦淫しない。生理中の女の人と性的な関係を持たない。

uk.L: [якщо] він не їв на горах і не підіймав своїх очей до бридких ідолів дому Ізраїлю, і не осквернив жінки свого ближнього, і не наближався до жінки в [її] нечистоті,
uk.B: який не їсть у святилищах на горах і не дивиться на ідолів дому Ізраїлю, який не осквернює жінки свого ближнього і не сходиться з жінкою під час її місячних,
uk.R: Він не їсть у святилищах на горах. Він не шукає допомоги в ідолів народу Ізраїлю. Він не чинить перелюбу з жінкою свого ближнього. Він не сходиться з жінкою під час її місячних.

decisions.choice: eaten on the mountains: eaten sacrificial meals at the hill shrines of other gods
decisions.reason: Sacrifices at the high places were followed by a meal, and to eat it was to take part in the worship (22:9; Hosea 4:13).

decisions.choice: lifted his eyes to the idols: looked to them in worship and for help
decisions.reason: To lift one's eyes to someone is to look to them for help (Psalm 121:1; 123:1). The idols are *gillulim* (see 6:4).

decisions.choice: his neighbor's wife ... a woman in her impurity: the laws of Leviticus
decisions.reason: Adultery with a neighbor's wife and relations with a woman during her monthly period were both forbidden (Leviticus 18:19-20; 20:10, 18). "Come near" is a polite way of speaking of sexual relations.

decisions.choice: filthy idols (L); idols (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for *gillulim*.

decisions.choice: have relations with a woman during her period (B); have sex with a woman during her monthly period (R)
alternatives: come near a woman in her impurity
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's polite expression. Balanced and Readable state its meaning plainly, as the decision at 16:1 sets out for frank passages.

decisions.choice: "durante su menstruación" (B); "durante su período mensual" (R)
decisions.reason: Said plainly and soberly, as in the Spanish of 22:10.

decisions.choice: "halali na mwanamke wakati wa hedhi yake"
decisions.reason: The plain, decent Swahili for the law of Leviticus, neither vague nor crude, as the English Balanced and Readable state it.

decisions.choice: tem relações com uma mulher durante a menstruação (B); tem relações sexuais (R)
alternatives: se aproxima de uma mulher impura
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-2): Literal keeps the Hebrew's polite "aproximar-se"; Balanced and Readable say plainly and soberly what the law forbids (m3), with the ordinary word "menstruação".

decisions.choice: idols (gillulim) "ጣዖታት" at every level, Literal included
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel terms list sets "ጣዖታት" for gillulim through the book; the contempt the English Literal shows with "filthy" is left to the meaning decision rather than added to a fixed term.

decisions.choice: "በተራሮች ላይ ባሉ መስገጃዎች" (at the shrines on the mountains)
decisions.reason: As the English Balanced and Readable, the place of the sacrificial meals is made explicit; Literal keeps "በተራሮች ላይ".

decisions.choice: पहाड़ी पूजा-स्थलों पर भोजन करना
decisions.reason: Eating on the mountains means eating sacrificial meals at the hill shrines (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew's words; Balanced and Readable name the shrines with Leviticus 26:30's पहाड़ी पूजा-स्थल.

decisions.choice: घिनौनी मूरतें (L); मूरतें (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's word for idols (gillulim) is a contemptuous one; Literal says घिनौनी मूरतें, as the English Literal says "filthy idols", and Balanced and Readable say मूरतें, the word Leviticus 26:30 uses. Proposed for Ezekiel as a whole.

decisions.choice: грязные идолы (L); идолы (B, R)
decisions.reason: Gillulim in the wording the Russian Ezekiel set at 14:3: "грязные идолы" at Literal, "идолы" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: не ест жертвенной пищи в святилищах на горах
decisions.reason: Eating "on the mountains" means the sacrificial meals at the hill shrines (m1): Balanced and Readable say so, as the English "mountain shrines".

decisions.choice: не сближается с женщиной во время её месячных (B); не ложится с женщиной во время её месячных (R)
alternatives: не приближается к женщине в нечистоте
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's polite "come near"; Balanced and Readable give its meaning plainly, as the English does and as the Russian Leviticus 18:19 does.

decisions.choice: "eat on the mountains" "山々の上で食べる" (L), "山の上の礼拝所で食事をする" (B, R); niddah "月経の汚れ" (L), "月経中" (B), "生理中" (R) (LEV 15:19, 18:19). The same wording in 18:11 and 18:15.
decisions.reason: m1: sacrificial meals at the hill shrines (R's word for bamot); m3: the Leviticus laws, in their Japanese words.

decisions.choice: gillulim "汚らわしい偶像" (L), "偶像" (B, R); nasa' 'enav "目を上げる" (L), "仰ぎ見る" (B), "助けを求める" (R).
decisions.reason: Ezekiel convention for gillulim; m2: looked to them in worship and for help.

source.text: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א יוֹנֶ֔ה חֲבֹלָת֥וֹ חוֹב֙ יָשִׁ֔יב גְּזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א יִגְזֹ֑ל לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב יִתֵּ֔ן וְעֵירֹ֖ם יְכַסֶּה־בָּֽגֶד׃

records.literal_gloss: and no one he oppresses, his pledge for a debt he returns, robbery he does not commit, his bread to the hungry he gives, and the naked he covers with clothing,

en.L: and has not oppressed anyone, has returned to the debtor his pledge, has committed no robbery, has given his bread to the hungry and covered the naked with clothing,
en.B: who does not oppress anyone but returns what a debtor gave him as a pledge, who does not rob but gives his food to the hungry and clothes the naked,
en.R: He does not take advantage of anyone. When someone gives him something to keep as a promise to pay back a loan, he returns it. He does not rob anyone. He gives food to hungry people and clothes to people who have nothing to wear.

pt.L: e não oprimir ninguém, devolver ao devedor o seu penhor, não cometer roubo, der o seu pão ao faminto e cobrir de roupa o nu,
pt.B: que não oprime ninguém, mas devolve o que o devedor lhe deu como penhor, que não rouba, mas dá o seu alimento ao faminto e veste o nu,
pt.R: Ele não se aproveita de ninguém. Quando alguém lhe dá alguma coisa como garantia de que vai pagar um empréstimo, ele a devolve. Ele não rouba ninguém. Dá comida a quem tem fome e roupa a quem não tem o que vestir.

fr.L: et n’a opprimé personne, a rendu au débiteur son gage, n’a pas commis de vol, a donné son pain à l’affamé et couvert de vêtements celui qui est nu,
fr.B: qui n’opprime personne mais rend à son débiteur ce qu’il a reçu en gage, qui ne vole pas mais donne sa nourriture à l’affamé et habille celui qui est nu,
fr.R: Il ne profite de personne. Quand quelqu’un lui laisse un objet pour promettre de rembourser un prêt, il le lui rend. Il ne vole personne. Il donne à manger à ceux qui ont faim et des vêtements à ceux qui n’ont rien à se mettre.

ko.L: 아무도 억압하지 않고, 빚진 자의 담보물을 돌려주며, 강도질하지 않고, 굶주린 자에게 자기 빵을 주며, 헐벗은 자에게 옷을 입혀 주고,
ko.B: 그는 아무도 억압하지 않고, 빚진 사람에게서 잡은 담보물을 돌려주며, 남의 것을 빼앗지 않고, 굶주린 사람에게 자기 음식을 나누어 주며, 헐벗은 사람에게 옷을 입혀 준다.
ko.R: 그는 아무도 괴롭히지 않는다. 누가 돈을 꾸면서 갚겠다는 약속으로 물건을 맡기면, 그것을 돌려준다. 그는 남의 것을 빼앗지 않는다. 그는 굶주린 사람에게 먹을 것을 주고, 입을 것이 없는 사람에게 옷을 준다.

es.L: y no ha oprimido a nadie, ha devuelto al deudor su prenda, no ha cometido robo, ha dado su pan al hambriento y ha cubierto con ropa al desnudo,
es.B: que no oprime a nadie, sino que devuelve al deudor lo que le dio en prenda, que no roba, sino que da su comida al hambriento y viste al desnudo,
es.R: No se aprovecha de nadie. Cuando alguien le deja algo como garantía de que pagará un préstamo, se lo devuelve. No roba a nadie. Da comida a los que tienen hambre y ropa a los que no tienen qué ponerse.

sw.L: na hajamdhulumu mtu, amemrudishia mdaiwa rehani yake, hajanyang'anya kitu, amempa mwenye njaa chakula chake na kumvika aliye uchi nguo,
sw.B: ambaye hamdhulumu mtu yeyote bali humrudishia mdaiwa rehani yake, ambaye hanyang'anyi bali humpa mwenye njaa chakula chake na kumvika aliye uchi,
sw.R: Hamdhulumu mtu yeyote. Mtu akimpa kitu kama rehani ili kuahidi kulipa mkopo, anakirudisha. Hamnyang'anyi mtu yeyote. Anawapa wenye njaa chakula na kuwapa nguo wasio na kitu cha kuvaa.

vi.L: không áp bức ai, trả lại vật cầm cho con nợ, không cướp bóc, ban bánh mình cho người đói và lấy áo che thân cho người trần truồng,
vi.B: không áp bức ai nhưng trả lại vật cầm cho con nợ, không cướp bóc nhưng chia thức ăn cho người đói và cho người trần truồng áo mặc,
vi.R: Người ấy không bóc lột ai. Khi có người đưa cho mình một món đồ để làm tin cho món nợ, người ấy trả lại. Người ấy không cướp của ai. Người ấy cho người đói thức ăn và cho người không có gì mặc quần áo.

am.L: ማንንም ባይጨቁን፣ ለባለ ዕዳው መያዣውን ቢመልስ፣ ቅሚያ ባይቀማ፣ እንጀራውን ለተራበ ቢሰጥ፣ የተራቆተውንም በልብስ ቢያለብስ፣
am.B: ማንንም አይጨቁንም፤ ይልቁንም ባለ ዕዳ በመያዣነት የሰጠውን ይመልሳል፤ አይቀማም፤ ይልቁንም ምግቡን ለተራበ ይሰጣል፤ የተራቆተውንም ያለብሳል።
am.R: ማንንም አይበዘብዝም። አንድ ሰው ብድር እንደሚመልስ ዋስትና አድርጎ አንድ ነገር ቢሰጠው መልሶ ይሰጠዋል። ማንንም አይዘርፍም። ለተራቡ ሰዎች ምግብ ይሰጣል፤ የሚለብሱት ለሌላቸውም ልብስ ይሰጣል።

hi.L: और किसी पर अंधेर नहीं किया, कर्ज़दार को उसकी गिरवी लौटा दी, कोई लूट नहीं की, भूखे को अपनी रोटी दी और नंगे को कपड़ा ओढ़ाया,
hi.B: जो किसी पर अत्याचार नहीं करता, बल्कि कर्ज़दार की गिरवी रखी वस्तु उसे लौटा देता है, जो लूटता नहीं बल्कि भूखे को अपना भोजन देता है और नंगे को कपड़े पहनाता है,
hi.R: वह किसी का फ़ायदा नहीं उठाता। जब कोई कर्ज़ लेकर उसके पास कोई चीज़ गिरवी रखता है, तो वह उसे लौटा देता है। वह किसी को नहीं लूटता। वह भूखों को भोजन देता है और जिनके पास पहनने को कुछ नहीं, उन्हें कपड़े देता है।

ru.L: и никого не притеснял, залог свой должнику возвращал, грабежа не совершал, хлеб свой голодному давал и нагого покрывал одеждой,
ru.B: который никого не притесняет, а возвращает должнику его залог, который не грабит, а даёт свой хлеб голодному и одевает нагого,
ru.R: Он никого не обижает. Если кто-то отдал ему вещь в залог, что вернёт долг, он возвращает её. Он никого не грабит. Он даёт еду голодным и одежду тем, кому нечего надеть.

ja.L: 人を虐げず、負債のある者に質を返し、強奪をせず、飢えた者に自分のパンを与え、裸の者に衣服を着せ、
ja.B: また、人を虐げず、借りた者から取った質を返し、強奪をせず、飢えた者に自分の食べ物を与え、裸の者に衣服を着せる。
ja.R: だれも食い物にしない。お金を貸すとき、返す約束のしるしとして預かった物は、返してやる。だれからも奪わない。飢えている人に食べ物を与え、着る物のない人に服を与える。

uk.L: і нікого не гнобив, повернув боржникові його заставу, не чинив грабунку, дав свій хліб голодному і покрив нагого одягом,
uk.B: який нікого не гнобить, а повертає боржникові його заставу, який не грабує, а дає свій хліб голодному і одягає нагого,
uk.R: Він ні з кого не користає. Коли хтось дає йому щось як запоруку, що поверне позику, він це повертає. Він нікого не грабує. Він дає їжу голодним і одяг тим, кому нема що вдягнути.

decisions.choice: returns the debtor's pledge: the law of pledges
decisions.reason: A lender could take a pledge, such as a cloak, as security for a loan, but the Law required him to give back a cloak by nightfall, since the poor man had nothing else to sleep in (Exodus 22:25-26; Deuteronomy 24:10-13).

decisions.choice: gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked: care for the poor
decisions.reason: Isaiah 58:7 names the same deeds as the fasting the LORD wants.

decisions.choice: pledge "መያዣ"
decisions.reason: The word of the pledge laws in Deuteronomy 24:6-13 on main.

decisions.choice: गिरवी
decisions.reason: The pledge for a debt is गिरवी, as Deuteronomy 24:6; Readable explains it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: залог
decisions.reason: The pledge of the law (m1) is "залог", as the Russian Deuteronomy 24:12-13; Readable explains what it is, as the English does.

decisions.choice: chavolah "質" (L, B), "返す約束のしるしとして預かった物" (R), as EXO 22:25 and DEU 24:12; hona "虐げる" (L, B), "食い物にする" (R). The same in 18:12 and 18:16.
decisions.reason: m1: the law of pledges, in the Pentateuch's Japanese words.

source.text: בַּנֶּ֣שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־יִתֵּ֗ן וְתַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔ח מֵעָ֖וֶל יָשִׁ֣יב יָד֑וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ יַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: at interest he does not lend, and profit he does not take, from injustice he turns back his hand, justice of truth he does between man and man,

en.L: has not lent at interest or taken profit, has turned back his hand from injustice, has done true justice between one person and another,
en.B: who does not lend at interest or take profit, who keeps his hand from wrongdoing and judges fairly between one person and another,
en.R: He does not charge interest when he lends money, and he does not make a profit from it. He keeps away from doing wrong. He is fair when he settles disputes between people.

pt.L: não emprestar com juros nem tomar lucro, desviar a sua mão da injustiça, fizer justiça verdadeira entre uma pessoa e outra,
pt.B: que não empresta com juros nem tira lucro, que afasta a mão da maldade e julga com justiça entre uma pessoa e outra,
pt.R: Ele não cobra juros quando empresta dinheiro e não tira lucro disso. Fica longe de fazer o mal. É justo quando resolve as brigas entre as pessoas.

fr.L: n’a pas prêté à intérêt ni pris d’usure, a détourné sa main de l’injustice, a rendu un jugement vrai entre un homme et un autre,
fr.B: qui ne prête pas à intérêt et ne prend pas d’usure, qui détourne sa main du mal et juge équitablement entre les gens,
fr.R: Il ne demande pas d’intérêt quand il prête de l’argent, et il ne s’enrichit pas sur le dos des autres. Il se tient loin du mal. Il est juste quand il règle les disputes entre les gens.

ko.L: 이자를 받고 꾸어 주지 않으며 이익을 챙기지 않고, 불의에서 손을 거두며, 사람과 사람 사이에 참된 공의로 재판하고,
ko.B: 그는 이자를 받고 돈을 꾸어 주지 않고 이익을 챙기지 않으며, 악한 일에서 손을 떼고, 사람들 사이의 다툼을 공정하게 판가름해 준다.
ko.R: 그는 돈을 꾸어 줄 때 이자를 받지 않고, 그것으로 이익을 남기지 않는다. 그는 나쁜 일을 멀리한다. 그는 사람들 사이의 다툼을 공정하게 해결해 준다.

es.L: no ha prestado con interés ni ha cobrado usura, ha retirado su mano de la injusticia, ha hecho juicio verdadero entre hombre y hombre,
es.B: que no presta con interés ni cobra usura, que aparta su mano de la maldad y juzga con justicia entre una persona y otra,
es.R: No cobra intereses cuando presta dinero, ni saca ganancias de ello. Se aparta de hacer el mal. Es justo cuando resuelve pleitos entre la gente.

sw.L: hajakopesha kwa riba wala kuchukua faida, ameurudisha mkono wake usitende uovu, ametenda hukumu ya kweli kati ya mtu na mtu,
sw.B: ambaye hakopeshi kwa riba wala hachukui faida, ambaye anauzuia mkono wake usitende mabaya na kuhukumu kwa haki kati ya mtu na mwenzake,
sw.R: Hatozi riba anapokopesha fedha, wala hajipatii faida kutoka kwake. Anajiepusha na kutenda mabaya. Anatenda haki anaposuluhisha mabishano kati ya watu.

vi.L: không cho vay lấy lãi, không ăn lời, rút tay lại khỏi sự gian ác, và thi hành công lý chân thật giữa người này với người kia,
vi.B: không cho vay lấy lãi hay ăn lời, giữ tay mình khỏi điều sai trái và xét xử công minh giữa người này với người kia,
vi.R: Người ấy không lấy lãi khi cho vay tiền, và không kiếm lời từ đó. Người ấy tránh xa việc làm sai trái. Người ấy công bằng khi phân xử những vụ tranh chấp giữa người ta với nhau.

am.L: በወለድ ባያበድር፣ ትርፍም ባይወስድ፣ እጁን ከግፍ ቢመልስ፣ በሰውና በሰው መካከል እውነተኛ ፍርድ ቢፈርድ፣
am.B: በወለድ አያበድርም፤ ትርፍም አይወስድም፤ እጁን ከግፍ ይከለክላል፤ በሰውና በሰው መካከልም በትክክል ይፈርዳል።
am.R: ገንዘብ ሲያበድር ወለድ አይጠይቅም፤ ከብድሩም ትርፍ አያገኝም። ክፉ ከማድረግ ይርቃል። በሰዎች መካከል ያለውን ክርክር ሲዳኝ ፍትሐዊ ነው።

hi.L: ब्याज पर उधार नहीं दिया, और बढ़ती नहीं ली, अन्याय से अपना हाथ रोक लिया, मनुष्य और मनुष्य के बीच सच्चा न्याय किया,
hi.B: जो ब्याज पर उधार नहीं देता और न मुनाफ़ा लेता है, जो अपना हाथ बुराई से रोके रखता है और लोगों के बीच निष्पक्ष न्याय करता है,
hi.R: जब वह पैसा उधार देता है तो ब्याज नहीं लेता, और न उससे मुनाफ़ा कमाता है। वह ग़लत काम से दूर रहता है। जब वह लोगों के झगड़े सुलझाता है, तो निष्पक्ष रहता है।

ru.L: в рост не давал и надбавки не брал, от неправды отводил свою руку, суд истинный совершал между человеком и человеком,
ru.B: который не даёт в долг под проценты и не берёт лишнего, удерживает свою руку от неправды и справедливо судит людей между собой,
ru.R: Когда он даёт деньги взаймы, он не берёт процентов и не наживается на этом. Он не делает ничего плохого. Когда люди спорят, он решает их спор честно.

ja.L: 利子を取って貸さず、利息を取らず、不正から手を引き、人と人との間で真実の公正を行い、
ja.B: 利子を取って貸さず、上乗せを取らず、不正から手を引き、人と人との間を公正に裁く。
ja.R: お金を貸すとき、利子を取らない。それでもうけようとしない。悪いことから遠ざかる。人々の争いを裁くときは公平である。

uk.L: не позичав на лихву і не брав надбавки, відвернув свою руку від кривди, чинив правдивий суд між людиною і людиною,
uk.B: який не позичає на лихву і не бере надбавки, який стримує свою руку від кривди і чесно судить між людьми,
uk.R: Він не бере відсотків, коли позичає гроші, і не наживається на цьому. Він тримається далеко від зла. Він чесний, коли розсуджує суперечки між людьми.

decisions.choice: interest and profit: the laws against making money from a needy neighbor
decisions.reason: The Law forbade an Israelite to charge interest on a loan to a fellow Israelite in need, whether in money or in food (Leviticus 25:35-37; Exodus 22:24). The two words may be two kinds of interest, or interest taken in advance and added at repayment.

decisions.choice: true justice between one person and another: fair judgment in disputes
decisions.reason: The phrase may describe a judge, or anyone called on to settle a quarrel (Zechariah 7:9).

decisions.choice: interest "ወለድ", profit "ትርፍ"; injustice (ʿawel) "ግፍ" (L, B), "ክፉ ነገር" (R)
decisions.reason: Interest and increase keep the words of Leviticus 25:36-37 and Deuteronomy 23:20 on main. ʿawel is kept apart from iniquity ("በደል") and from transgression ("መተላለፍ") through the chapter.

decisions.choice: ब्याज; बढ़ती (L); मुनाफ़ा (B, R)
decisions.reason: Interest and profit take the forms of Leviticus 25:36: ब्याज and बढ़ती at Literal, ब्याज and मुनाफ़ा at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: в рост, надбавка (L); под проценты, лишнее (B); проценты, наживаться (R)
decisions.reason: Neshek and tarbit, the two words for profit on a loan (m1), in the wording of the Russian Leviticus 25:36-37 ("процент и надбавка"); "лихва" is no longer current.

decisions.choice: neshekh "利子", tarbit "利息" (L), "上乗せ" (B), "もうけ" (R), as LEV 25:36. The same in 18:13 and 18:17.
decisions.reason: m1: the laws against making money from a needy neighbour, in the Leviticus words.

source.text: בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֧י יְהַלֵּ֛ךְ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י שָׁמַ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֱמֶ֑ת צַדִּ֥יק הוּא֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: in my statutes he walks and my judgments he keeps, to do faithfulness — righteous he [is]; he will surely live, declares [the] Lord Yahweh.

en.L: [if] he walks in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and keeps {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments, acting faithfully, he [is] righteous; he will surely live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: and who follows {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and keeps {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings faithfully. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He lives by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and is careful to obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rules. A man like that is righteous. He will certainly live, says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: andar nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e guardar os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} juízos, agindo com fidelidade, ele [é] justo; certamente viverá, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.B: e que segue os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e guarda fielmente as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças. Esse homem é justo; certamente viverá, declara o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.
pt.R: Ele vive pelas {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis e tem o cuidado de obedecer às {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} regras. Um homem assim é justo. Ele com certeza vai viver, diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}}.

fr.L: [s’]il marche dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et garde {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements, en agissant avec fidélité, il [est] juste ; il vivra certainement, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: et qui suit {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et observe fidèlement {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ordonnances. Cet homme est juste ; il vivra certainement, déclare le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il vit selon {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et fait attention à obéir à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles. Un tel homme est juste. Il vivra, c’est certain, dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}.

ko.L: 내 규례를 따라 걷고 내 법도를 지켜 신실하게 행한다면, 그는 의인이다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그는 내 규례를 따르고 내 법도를 성실하게 지킨다. 그런 사람이 의인이다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.
ko.R: 그는 내 법대로 살고 내 규칙을 잘 지킨다. 그런 사람은 의롭다. 그는 반드시 살 것이다. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}의 말이다.

es.L: [si] anda en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y guarda {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} decretos, actuando con fidelidad, ese [es] justo; ciertamente vivirá, declara el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.B: y que sigue {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y cumple fielmente {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas. Ese hombre es justo; ciertamente vivirá, afirma el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Vive según {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y obedece con cuidado {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas. Un hombre así es justo. Ciertamente vivirá, dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: [ikiwa] anaenenda katika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuzishika hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, akitenda kwa uaminifu, yeye [ni] mwenye haki; hakika ataishi, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: na anayefuata kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kushika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kwa uaminifu. Mtu huyo ni mwenye haki; hakika ataishi, asema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Anaishi kwa kufuata sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kuwa mwangalifu kuzitii. Mtu kama huyo ni mwenye haki. Ataishi kwa hakika, anasema Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: [nếu] người ấy bước đi theo luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và giữ các mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hành động cách trung tín, thì người ấy [là] công chính; người ấy chắc chắn sẽ sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: và đi theo luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, trung tín giữ các mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người như thế là công chính; người ấy chắc chắn sẽ sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Người ấy sống theo luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và cẩn thận vâng giữ các quy định của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Người như thế là công chính. Người ấy chắc chắn sẽ sống, Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

am.L: በሥርዓቶቼ ቢሄድ፣ ፍርዶቼንም ቢጠብቅ፣ በታማኝነትም ቢያደርግ፣ እርሱ ጻድቅ [ነው]፤ በእርግጥ በሕይወት ይኖራል፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.B: ሥርዓቶቼን ይከተላል፤ ደንቦቼንም በታማኝነት ይጠብቃል። ያ ሰው ጻድቅ ነው፤ በእርግጥ በሕይወት ይኖራል፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።
am.R: በሥርዓቶቼ ይኖራል፤ ሕጎቼንም በጥንቃቄ ይታዘዛል። እንዲህ ያለው ሰው ጻድቅ ነው። በእርግጥ በሕይወት ይኖራል፣ ይላል ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}።

hi.L: मेरी विधियों पर चलता है और मेरे नियमों का पालन करता है, कि सच्चाई से काम करे, वह धर्मी [है]; वह निश्चय जीवित रहेगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.B: और जो मेरी विधियों पर चलता और सच्चाई से मेरे नियमों का पालन करता है। ऐसा मनुष्य धर्मी है; वह निश्चय जीवित रहेगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है।
hi.R: वह मेरी विधियों के अनुसार जीता है और ध्यान से मेरे नियमों को मानता है। ऐसा आदमी धर्मी है। वह निश्चय ही जीवित रहेगा, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} कहते हैं।

ru.L: по {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} установлениям ходил и {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} правила соблюдал, поступая верно, — он праведен; он непременно будет жить, — слово Владыки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: и который следует {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} установлениям и верно соблюдает {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} правила. Такой человек праведен; он непременно будет жить, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Он живёт по {{deity_pronoun:моим|Моим}} законам и старательно соблюдает {{deity_pronoun:мои|Мои}} правила. Такой человек праведен. Он обязательно будет жить, — говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: わたしの定めに歩み、わたしの掟を守って真実を行うなら、彼は正しい者であり、必ず生きる――{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}の言葉――。
ja.B: わたしの定めに従って歩み、わたしの掟を忠実に守る。このような人こそ正しい人であり、必ず生きる、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は告げる。
ja.R: わたしのきまりに従って生き、わたしのおきてを注意深く守る。このような人は正しい人だ。その人は必ず生きる、と{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は言う。

uk.L: [якщо] він ходить {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} постановами і дотримується {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} законів, чинячи вірно, — він праведний; він неодмінно житиме, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: і який живе за {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} постановами і вірно дотримується {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} законів. Такий чоловік праведний; він неодмінно житиме, говорить Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Він живе за {{deity_pronoun:моїми|Моїми}} законами і дбайливо слухається {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} правил. Такий чоловік праведний. Він неодмінно житиме, каже Владика {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: he is righteous; he will surely live: the verdict on the case
decisions.reason: The words sound like the verdict of a priest or judge (compare Leviticus 18:5). To "live" is to be accepted by the LORD and to escape the judgment that is coming.

decisions.choice: statutes, judgments (L); statutes, rulings (B); laws, rules (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording in Ezekiel for *chuqqot* ("statutes" / "statutes" / "laws") and *mishpatim* ("judgments" / "rulings" / "rules"), as published in chapters 1-7.

decisions.choice: ’prescriptions’, ’jugements’ (L); ’prescriptions’, ’ordonnances’ (B); ’lois’, ’règles’ (R) for chuqqot and mishpatim, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The book’s term list, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: ’il vivra certainement’
decisions.reason: The doubled Hebrew verb is an emphasis; French gives it with an adverb.

decisions.choice: "규례" (L, B), "법" (R) for chuqqot; "법도" (L, B), "규칙" (R) for mishpatim
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, as the Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: Balanced ends the description of verses 6-8 in full sentences and starts the verdict here
decisions.reason: Korean cannot carry one conditional clause across four verses at Balanced; each verse is a closed sentence, and Literal keeps the long "if" sentence that ends here.

decisions.choice: "estatutos ... decretos" (L); "estatutos ... normas" (B); "leyes ... normas" (R)
decisions.reason: Chuqqot and mishpatim as the terms note sets them for Ezekiel, kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: statutes / judgments: "kanuni" / "hukumu" (L); "kanuni" / "maagizo" (B); "sheria" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for chuqqot and mishpatim in Ezekiel, with the Pentateuch's "kanuni" for statutes (Leviticus 18:5); Readable uses "sheria" for both, as the English Readable says "laws" and "rules".

decisions.choice: chuqqot "luật lệ" at every level; mishpatim "mạng lệnh" (L, B), "quy định" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's words, following the Pentateuch; used unchanged through these chapters.

decisions.choice: statutes "ሥርዓቶች"; judgments "ፍርዶች" (L), "ደንቦች" (B), "ሕጎች" (R); "he will surely live" "በእርግጥ በሕይወት ይኖራል"
decisions.reason: The pair keeps the Amharic of Leviticus 18:5 on main at each level, as Ezekiel 20 does where it quotes that verse.

decisions.choice: विधियाँ, नियम (every level)
decisions.reason: Statutes and judgments take the forms of Ezekiel 11:12 and Leviticus 26, through these chapters; Readable keeps the same pair, as 5:6.

decisions.choice: установления, правила (L, B); законы, правила (R)
decisions.reason: Huqqot and mishpatim in the wording the Russian Ezekiel set at 11:12 and 11:20.

decisions.choice: непременно будет жить (L, B); обязательно будет жить (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict of the case (m1); the doubled verb is kept as an emphatic adverb, here and through the chapter.

decisions.choice: chuqqot "定め" (L, B), "きまり" (R); mishpatim "掟" (L, B), "おきて" (R); "walk in" "…に歩む" (L), "…に従って歩む" (B), "…に従って生きる" (R). Through 18-20.
alternatives: "掟" for chuqqot and "定め" for mishpatim
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch and Psalms terms (LEV 18:5, DEU 4:1, PSA 119 table): chuqqim 定め / mishpatim 掟. Used through the whole book, 5:6-7 included.

decisions.choice: chayoh yichyeh "必ず生きる" (every level); ne'um "――…の言葉――" (L), "、と…は告げる" (B), "、と…は言う" (R).
decisions.reason: Ezekiel conventions; the verdict of each case keeps one form.

source.text: וְהוֹלִ֥יד בֵּן־פָּרִ֖יץ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ דָּ֑ם וְעָ֣שָׂה אָ֔ח מֵאַחַ֖ד מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [if] he fathers a son, violent, a shedder of blood, and he does [to a brother] any one of these,

en.L: But [if] he fathers a son who is violent, a shedder of blood, who does any one of these [things],
en.B: But suppose he has a son who is violent, who sheds blood and does any of these things,
en.R: But suppose this man has a son who is violent and kills people. He does these evil things,

pt.L: Mas, [se] ele gerar um filho violento, derramador de sangue, que fizer qualquer uma destas [coisas],
pt.B: Mas imaginem que ele tenha um filho violento, que derrama sangue e faz qualquer uma dessas coisas,
pt.R: Mas imaginem que esse homem tenha um filho violento, que mata pessoas. Ele faz essas coisas más,

fr.L: Mais [s’]il engendre un fils violent, qui verse le sang, qui fait l’une de ces [choses],
fr.B: Mais supposons qu’il ait un fils violent, qui verse le sang et fait l’une de ces choses,
fr.R: Mais supposons que cet homme ait un fils violent, qui tue des gens. Il fait ces choses mauvaises,

ko.L: 그러나 그가 아들을 낳았는데, [그 아들이] 난폭하여 피를 흘리고, 이런 일 가운데 하나라도 저지른다면,
ko.B: 그런데 그에게 아들이 있어, 그 아들이 난폭하여 피를 흘리고 이런 악한 일 가운데 어떤 것을 한다고 하자.
ko.R: 그런데 이 사람에게 아들이 있다고 하자. 그 아들은 난폭하여 사람을 죽이고, 이런 악한 일들을 한다.

es.L: Pero [si] engendra un hijo violento, derramador de sangre, que hace cualquiera de estas [cosas],
es.B: Pero supongamos que tiene un hijo violento, que derrama sangre y hace cualquiera de estas cosas,
es.R: Pero supongamos que este hombre tiene un hijo violento que mata a la gente. Hace estas cosas malas,

sw.L: Lakini [ikiwa] amezaa mwana aliye mkatili, mwaga damu, anayefanya mojawapo ya [mambo] haya,
sw.B: Lakini tuseme ana mwana aliye mkatili, anayemwaga damu na kufanya lolote kati ya mambo haya,
sw.R: Lakini tuseme mtu huyu ana mwana aliye mkatili na anayeua watu. Anatenda mambo haya mabaya,

vi.L: Nhưng [nếu] người ấy sinh một đứa con trai hung bạo, làm đổ máu, làm một trong những [điều] này,
vi.B: Nhưng giả sử người ấy có một đứa con trai hung bạo, làm đổ máu và làm một trong những điều ấy,
vi.R: Nhưng giả sử người ấy có một đứa con trai hung bạo và giết người. Nó làm những điều gian ác ấy,

am.L: ጨካኝና ደም አፍሳሽ የሆነ ልጅ ቢወልድ፣ ከእነዚህም [ነገሮች] አንዱን ቢያደርግ፣
am.B: ነገር ግን ይህ ሰው ጨካኝ የሆነ፣ ደም የሚያፈስና ከእነዚህ ነገሮች ማንኛውንም የሚያደርግ ልጅ አለው እንበል።
am.R: ነገር ግን ይህ ሰው ጨካኝና ሰዎችን የሚገድል ልጅ አለው እንበል። ልጁ እነዚህን ክፉ ነገሮች ያደርጋል፤

hi.L: पर [यदि] उससे एक पुत्र उत्पन्न हो जो हिंसक, लहू बहानेवाला हो, और इनमें से कोई भी [काम] करे,
hi.B: पर मान लो उसका एक पुत्र है जो हिंसक है, जो ख़ून बहाता है और इनमें से कोई भी काम करता है,
hi.R: पर मान लो इस आदमी का एक बेटा है जो हिंसक है और लोगों की हत्या करता है। वह ये बुरे काम करता है,

ru.L: Но [если] он родит сына, насильника, проливающего кровь, и тот сделает что-либо одно из этого,
ru.B: Но допустим, у него родился сын — жестокий человек, который проливает кровь и делает что-нибудь из этого,
ru.R: Но допустим, у этого человека есть сын, жестокий человек, который убивает людей. Он делает всё это зло,

ja.L: しかし彼が、乱暴で血を流す息子をもうけ、その子がこれらのうちの一つでも行い、
ja.B: しかし、その人に乱暴で血を流す息子が生まれ、その息子がこれらのことのどれかを行うとする。
ja.R: しかし、この人に息子がいて、その息子が乱暴で人を殺すとしよう。その息子は、こうした悪いことをする。

uk.L: Але [якщо] він породить сина-насильника, що проливає кров, що чинить щось одне з цього,
uk.B: Але припустімо, що в нього є син-насильник, що проливає кров і чинить щось із цього,
uk.R: Але припустімо, що в цього чоловіка є син, жорстокий і вбивця. Він чинить ці лихі діла,

decisions.choice: does any one of these: the son does the evil deeds that the father avoided
alternatives: does to a brother any of these
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is awkward. It may mean "any one of these things", or, with a small change, "to a brother any of these things". Either way the son does the wrongs listed in verses 11-13.

decisions.choice: насильника
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a violent man, a robber who uses force: "насильник" at Literal, a man of violence; Balanced and Readable say "жестокий человек".

source.text: וְה֕וּא אֶת־כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ אָכַ֔ל וְאֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ טִמֵּֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: and he himself all these did not do, but also on the mountains he has eaten, and his neighbor's wife he has defiled,

en.L: though he himself did none of these [things], who even eats on the mountains and defiles his neighbor's wife,
en.B: though the father himself did none of them. This son eats at the mountain shrines, defiles his neighbor's wife,
en.R: though his father did none of them. The son eats at the mountain shrines. He commits adultery with his neighbor's wife.

pt.L: embora ele mesmo não tenha feito nenhuma destas [coisas], que até come sobre os montes e contamina a mulher do seu próximo,
pt.B: embora o pai não tenha feito nenhuma delas. Esse filho come nos santuários dos montes, contamina a mulher do seu próximo,
pt.R: embora o pai dele não tenha feito nenhuma delas. O filho come nos santuários dos montes. Comete adultério com a mulher do seu vizinho.

fr.L: alors que lui-même n’a fait aucune de ces [choses], [un fils] qui mange même sur les montagnes et souille la femme de son prochain,
fr.B: alors que le père lui-même n’en a fait aucune. Ce fils mange dans les sanctuaires des montagnes, souille la femme de son prochain,
fr.R: alors que son père n’en a fait aucune. Le fils mange dans les sanctuaires des montagnes. Il commet l’adultère avec la femme de son voisin.

ko.L: 그 자신은 이 모든 일 가운데 아무것도 하지 않았는데, [그 아들은] 산 위에서 [제물을] 먹고, 이웃의 아내를 더럽히며,
ko.B: 아버지는 이런 일을 하나도 하지 않았는데, 이 아들은 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹고, 이웃의 아내를 더럽힌다.
ko.R: 그의 아버지는 이런 일을 하나도 하지 않았다. 그러나 아들은 산 위의 신당에서 제물을 먹는다. 그는 이웃의 아내와 간음한다.

es.L: aunque él mismo no hizo ninguna de estas [cosas], que incluso come sobre los montes y deshonra a la mujer de su prójimo,
es.B: aunque el padre no hizo ninguna de ellas. Este hijo come en los santuarios de los montes, deshonra a la mujer de su prójimo,
es.R: aunque su padre no hizo ninguna de ellas. El hijo come en los santuarios de los montes. Comete adulterio con la mujer de su prójimo.

sw.L: ingawa yeye mwenyewe hakufanya lolote kati ya [mambo] haya, ambaye hata hula juu ya milima na kumtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake,
sw.B: ingawa baba mwenyewe hakufanya lolote kati ya hayo. Mwana huyu hula katika madhabahu za milimani, humtia unajisi mke wa jirani yake,
sw.R: ingawa baba yake hakufanya lolote kati ya hayo. Mwana huyo anakula katika madhabahu za milimani. Anazini na mke wa jirani yake.

vi.L: dù chính người cha không làm điều nào trong những [điều] ấy, mà đứa con lại ăn trên các núi và làm ô uế vợ người lân cận,
vi.B: dù chính người cha không làm điều nào trong những điều ấy. Đứa con này ăn của cúng tại các miếu trên núi, làm ô uế vợ người lân cận,
vi.R: dù cha nó không làm điều nào trong những điều ấy. Đứa con ăn của cúng tại các miếu thờ trên núi. Nó ngoại tình với vợ người lân cận.

am.L: እርሱ ራሱ ግን ከእነዚህ [ነገሮች] አንዱንም ባያደርግ፣ [ልጁ] በተራሮች ላይ እንኳ ቢበላ፣ የባልንጀራውንም ሚስት ቢያረክስ፣
am.B: አባቱ ራሱ ግን ከእነዚህ አንዱንም አላደረገም። ይህ ልጅ በተራሮች ላይ ባሉ መስገጃዎች ይበላል፤ የባልንጀራውንም ሚስት ያረክሳል፤
am.R: አባቱ ግን ከእነዚህ አንዱንም አላደረገም። ልጁ በተራሮች ላይ ባሉ መስገጃዎች ይበላል። ከባልንጀራው ሚስት ጋር ያመነዝራል።

hi.L: यद्यपि उसने स्वयं इनमें से कोई [काम] नहीं किया, जो पहाड़ों पर भी खाता है और अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी को अशुद्ध करता है,
hi.B: यद्यपि पिता ने स्वयं इनमें से कोई काम नहीं किया था। यह पुत्र पहाड़ी पूजा-स्थलों पर भोजन करता है, अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी को भ्रष्ट करता है,
hi.R: यद्यपि उसके पिता ने इनमें से कोई काम नहीं किया था। बेटा पहाड़ी पूजा-स्थलों पर भोजन करता है। वह अपने पड़ोसी की पत्नी के साथ व्यभिचार करता है।

ru.L: хотя сам он ничего этого не делал, — а он и на горах ест, и жену своего ближнего оскверняет,
ru.B: хотя сам отец ничего такого не делал. Этот сын ест жертвенную пищу в святилищах на горах, оскверняет жену своего ближнего,
ru.R: хотя его отец ничего такого не делал. Сын ест жертвенную пищу в святилищах на горах. Он вступает в связь с чужой женой.

ja.L: ――彼自身はこれらのことを何一つ行わなかったのに――その子は山々の上で食べ、隣人の妻を汚し、
ja.B: 父自身はそのようなことを何一つ行わなかったのに、この息子は山の上の礼拝所で食事をし、隣人の妻を汚し、
ja.R: 父親はそのようなことを何一つしなかった。それなのに、この息子は、山の上の礼拝所で食事をする。隣人の妻と姦淫する。

uk.L: хоч сам він нічого з цього не чинив, — що навіть їсть на горах і осквернює жінку свого ближнього,
uk.B: хоч сам батько нічого з цього не чинив. Цей син їсть у святилищах на горах, осквернює жінку свого ближнього,
uk.R: хоч його батько нічого з цього не чинив. Син їсть у святилищах на горах. Він чинить перелюб із жінкою свого ближнього.

decisions.choice: he himself did none of these: the father did none of these evil things
alternatives: the son did none of the good things
decisions.reason: The words are short. They can mean that the father did none of these evil things, or that the son did none of the good things the father did. Either way the contrast is between the two.

decisions.choice: the father (B); his father (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the father, following the first reading (m1), and name "this son" as the one who does the evil.

decisions.choice: отец (B); его отец (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the father as the one who did none of these things (m1), as the English does, and name "этот сын" as the one who does the evil.

decisions.choice: L sets "he himself did none of these" off with dashes, keeping the Hebrew's unclear "he"; B and R name the father, as the English B and R.
decisions.reason: m1 (uncertain): the father did none of these evil things.

source.text: עָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנָ֔ה גְּזֵל֣וֹת גָּזָ֔ל חֲבֹ֖ל לֹ֣א יָשִׁ֑יב וְאֶל־הַגִּלּוּלִים֙ נָשָׂ֣א עֵינָ֔יו תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] poor and needy he has oppressed, robberies he has committed, a pledge he does not return, and to the idols he has lifted his eyes, abomination he has done,

en.L: has oppressed the poor and needy, has committed robbery, has not returned a pledge, has lifted his eyes to the filthy idols, has done abomination,
en.B: oppresses the poor and needy, commits robbery, does not return what was pledged, looks to the idols, does detestable things,
en.R: He takes advantage of poor and needy people. He robs people. He does not give back what was given him as a promise to pay. He looks to idols for help, and he does disgusting things.

pt.L: oprime o pobre e o necessitado, comete roubos, não devolve o penhor, levanta os seus olhos para os ídolos imundos, pratica abominação,
pt.B: oprime o pobre e o necessitado, comete roubos, não devolve o que recebeu como penhor, olha para os ídolos, pratica coisas detestáveis,
pt.R: Ele se aproveita dos pobres e dos necessitados. Rouba as pessoas. Não devolve o que recebeu como garantia de pagamento. Olha para os ídolos pedindo ajuda e faz coisas repugnantes.

fr.L: opprime le pauvre et l’indigent, commet des vols, ne rend pas le gage, lève les yeux vers les idoles immondes, commet l’abomination,
fr.B: opprime le pauvre et l’indigent, commet des vols, ne rend pas ce qu’on lui a laissé en gage, se tourne vers les idoles, fait des choses détestables,
fr.R: Il profite des pauvres et des gens dans le besoin. Il vole les gens. Il ne rend pas ce qu’on lui a laissé pour promettre de payer. Il compte sur les idoles pour l’aider, et il fait des choses dégoûtantes.

ko.L: 가난하고 궁핍한 자를 억압하고, 강도질하며, 담보물을 돌려주지 않고, 더러운 우상들에게 눈을 들며, 가증한 일을 행하고,
ko.B: 그는 가난하고 궁핍한 사람을 억압하고, 남의 것을 빼앗으며, 담보물을 돌려주지 않고, 우상들을 바라보며, 역겨운 짓을 한다.
ko.R: 그는 가난하고 어려운 사람들을 괴롭힌다. 그는 남의 것을 빼앗는다. 그는 빚을 갚겠다는 약속으로 맡은 물건을 돌려주지 않는다. 그는 우상들에게 도움을 구하고, 역겨운 일을 한다.

es.L: oprime al pobre y al necesitado, comete robos, no devuelve la prenda, alza sus ojos a los ídolos inmundos, hace abominación,
es.B: oprime al pobre y al necesitado, comete robos, no devuelve lo que recibió en prenda, pone los ojos en los ídolos, hace cosas detestables,
es.R: Se aprovecha de los pobres y de los necesitados. Roba a la gente. No devuelve lo que le dejaron como garantía de pago. Busca la ayuda de los ídolos, y hace cosas repugnantes.

sw.L: amemdhulumu maskini na mhitaji, amenyang'anya, hajarudisha rehani, ameinua macho yake kwa sanamu chafu, ametenda chukizo,
sw.B: humdhulumu maskini na mhitaji, hunyang'anya, harudishi rehani, huzitazamia sanamu, hutenda matendo ya kuchukiza,
sw.R: Anawadhulumu maskini na wahitaji. Anawanyang'anya watu. Harudishi kile alichopewa kama rehani. Anazitazamia sanamu ili zimsaidie, naye anatenda mambo ya kinyaa.

vi.L: áp bức người nghèo khó và thiếu thốn, cướp bóc, không trả lại vật cầm, ngước mắt lên các thần tượng nhơ bẩn, làm điều ghê tởm,
vi.B: áp bức người nghèo khó và thiếu thốn, cướp bóc, không trả lại vật cầm, ngửa trông các thần tượng, làm những việc ghê tởm,
